snippet.title: Of Ash and Steel - Shattered Faith DLC Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5059740/Of_Ash_and_Steel_Shattered_Faith  

Shattered Faith DLC expands the world Of Ash and Steel with a brand new storyline, unique magical powers and weapons to fight foes both well-known and previously unseen, and even more uncharted land to explore on the other side of Grayshaft. Join a mysterious expedition headed to the lost and forgotten corners of Grayshaft and retrace the steps of the Primestriders in search of powerful artefacts, meeting friends for life and fear-instilling foes. Dig deep into the secrect of those long gone and watch Tristan realize that even if your path was set in stone by fate itself, you can still try and break the mold.
